adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, `save()` always sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and then, on success, does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`; if `categoryId` is `null`/blank, the server falls back to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` (see `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`), but the client still looks up `findById(null)` and sets `category` to `undefined`, so the UI can show no category until a reload/rehydration. Also, `delete()` calls `destroyRecord().then(...)` without a `.catch(...)`, so a failed delete produces no user-visible error and leaves the record in the list silently.
